name: repo-quiz
description: After each reply, a sidebar asks an interview-style question or shares a grounded fact about the repository you are working in.

questionsPerHour.title: Questions per hour
questionsPerHour.description: The most interview questions started per repository in any hour. 0 means facts only.

rapidReplyMinutes.title: Rapid reply window (minutes)
rapidReplyMinutes.description: When your messages come closer together than this many minutes, a fact appears instead of a question. 0 turns the rule off.

mode.title: What to show
mode.description: Questions and facts, questions only, or facts only.

refresherEvery.title: Refresher question every
refresherEvery.description: Every Nth question is about code that has not changed in a while. 0 means never.

refresherMinAgeDays.title: Refresher minimum age (days)
refresherMinAgeDays.description: How many days a file must go unchanged to count as refresher material.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.description: The interview bar the questions aim for.

categories.title: Question categories
categories.description: Comma-separated categories to rotate through, or "all". The categories are: architecture, how code works, system design, debugging, language semantics, concurrency, testing, security, performance, data modeling.

flawReview.title: Flaw review
flawReview.description: Show a "possible flaw" callout when the research behind a card exposes a real problem in the code.

sourcePolicy.title: Documentation sources
sourcePolicy.description: Whether cards may cite well-regarded unofficial pages when no official documentation covers a point.

excludePaths.title: Excluded paths
excludePaths.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for files never used as a question's focus, such as "generated/**, *.pb.swift", or "none".

questionModel.title: Question model
questionModel.description: Writes each question and its model answer. Each choice uses the newest model of that family your Claude Code knows.

questionEffort.title: Question effort
questionEffort.description: How hard the question model thinks. Lower is faster and cheaper.

factModel.title: Fact model
factModel.description: Writes each batch of "Did you know?" facts.

gradeModel.title: Grading model
gradeModel.description: Grades your typed answer when you press Grade.

steWriting.title: Simplified Technical English
steWriting.description: Ask the models to write in a plain style based on ASD-STE100: one idea per sentence, the active voice, simple tenses and plain words.

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudgetUsd.description: Estimated API-equivalent spend per day, in US dollars, after which repo-quiz stops starting model runs.

openPaneOnStart.title: Open the pane at start
openPaneOnStart.description: Open the sidebar when a session starts. /repo-quiz always opens it.

toastOnNewQuestion.title: Notify on a new question
toastOnNewQuestion.description: Show a toast when a new question is ready and the pane is hidden.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show repo-quiz's state and today's estimated cost in the status line.

telemetry.title: Local telemetry
telemetry.description: Records kept on this machine for the Stats view. "counts only" keeps no text you typed and no card content; "full" also keeps both, for reviewing quality later.
